    Lemma 12.3: flat mesh perturbations #

    deformation-refinements.tex (lem:flat-mesh-perturbations). Let C = kQ/(r₁, …, r_t) be finite-dimensional and graded, with homogeneous relations of degree at least two, and assume that the presentations of the simple modules obtained by splitting each relation according to its arrows are projective resolutions of length at most two. Choose N with C_d = 0 for d ≥ N and perturbations f_i of strictly higher degree, and put B = kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r₁ − f₁, …, r_t − f_t). Then B has the dimensions of C, every homogeneous path basis of C lifts to a basis of B, and the perturbed presentations are again resolutions.

    The proof is the source's: exactness of the perturbed presentations at the arrow term (contextual relations are sorted by their last factor), the dimension identities ZH = I and ZH_B = I + K, and the spanning bound H_B ≤ H.

    Conventions. The source uses right modules and splits relations by their first arrow; we use the representables C(−, x) and split relations by their last arrow, the form in which the mesh relations and their exact sequences appear in Section 2 (the lemma for one convention is the lemma for the opposite quiver in the other). Relations are indexed by their target.
